title: Resolving closure and six oplax model edge squares
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring and assume the unbounded derived section-module categories exist for every scheme. For a scheme morphism f:X→Y use the fixed section cochain tensor, transported derived tensor, localization Q, exact section pullback F, derived pullback L and its natural isomorphism ε: Q⋙L ≅ F⋙Q, binary maps s=modelTensor over Y and t=modelTensor over X, ordinary oplax tensor arrow β and scalar unit u, and localized regular-unit isomorphisms eY,eX of [def-pd-section-resolving-oplax-constraint-data]. Let μ be a natural tensor arrow L(M⊗N)→LM⊗LN and let v:LQ(1)→Q(1). Assume SectionHypotheses, namely for every flat-term K-flat pair A,B the equation μ(QA,QB)≫(εA⊗εB)≫t(FA,FB) = L(s(A,B))≫ε(A⊗B)≫Q(β(A,B)), and v=ε(1)≫Q(u). Composition here is in Lean order. For every triple P,Q,H of flat-term K-flat section cochain complexes on Y, the four totals P⊗Q, Q⊗H, (P⊗Q)⊗H, P⊗(Q⊗H) are resolving, and the pullbacks of P,Q,H and these four totals are resolving (ResolvingClosure). Moreover the six EdgeIdentification squares hold for the fixed vertex0 through vertex5, source and target associators and μ. Equivalently, ResolvingClosure Λ f P Q H ∧ SectionEdges Λ f μ P Q H holds. This assertion does not include path composition or path equality.
